en.t: Accession of Emperor Guangwu of Han
en.s: Emperor Guangwu of Han (Chinese: 漢光武帝; 15 January 5 BC – 29 March AD 57), personal name Liu Xiu (劉秀), courtesy name Wenshu (文叔), was the founding emperor of the Chinese Eastern Han dynasty. Through the Eastern Han's suppression and conquest of regional warlords, the dynasty's rule over the whole of China proper was consolidated by the time of Emperor Guangwu's death in AD 57.

zh.s: 汉光武帝（汉字：漢光武帝；公元前5年1月15日—公元57年3月29日），本名刘秀（劉秀），字文叔（文叔），是中国东汉王朝的开国皇帝。到公元57年光武帝去世时，东汉通过镇压并征服各地军阀，巩固了对整个中国本土的统治。

en.s: The Battle of Maserfield (or Maserfeld, "marsh (border) field"; Welsh: Maes Cogwy), was fought on 5 August 641 or 642, between the Anglo-Saxon kings Oswald of Northumbria and Penda of Mercia, ending in Oswald's defeat, death, and dismemberment. The battle was also known as Cogwy to the Welsh, with their countrymen from Pengwern participating in the battle (according to the probably ninth-century Canu Heledd), probably as allies of the Mercians. Bede reports the commonly accepted date given above; the Welsh Annales Cambriae is generally considered incorrect in giving the year of the battle as 644.

zh.s: 马瑟菲尔德战役（又写作Maserfeld，意为“沼泽地（边界）”；威尔士语：Maes Cogwy）发生于641年或642年8月5日，交战双方是诺森布里亚国王奥斯瓦尔德和麦西亚国王彭达。奥斯瓦尔德战败、身亡，尸体被肢解。威尔士人也称此战为科格维；据可能成书于9世纪的《海莱德之歌》，彭伯恩的威尔士人也参加了战斗，可能是麦西亚人的盟友。比德记载了普遍接受的日期；《威尔士编年史》将战役年份记为644年，通常被认为有误。

en.t: Battle of Maserfield: Penda of Mercia defeats and kills Oswald of Northumbria
en.s: Penda (died 15 November 655) was a 7th-century king of Mercia, the Anglo-Saxon kingdom in what is today the Midlands. A pagan at a time when Christianity was taking hold in many of the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms, Penda took over the Severn Valley in 628 following the Battle of Cirencester before participating in the defeat of the powerful Northumbrian king Edwin at the Battle of Hatfield Chase in 633.

zh.t: 马瑟菲尔德战役：麦西亚的彭达击败并杀死诺森布里亚的奥斯瓦尔德
zh.s: 彭达（655年11月15日去世）是7世纪麦西亚国王；麦西亚是盎格鲁-撒克逊王国，位于今英格兰中部地区。当时许多盎格鲁-撒克逊王国正逐渐接受基督教，彭达仍信奉异教。628年，他在塞伦塞斯特战役后控制塞文河谷；633年又参与哈特菲尔德蔡斯战役，击败强大的诺森布里亚国王埃德温。

en.s: The Battle of Tettenhall (sometimes called the Battle of Wednesfield or Wōdnesfeld) took place, according to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, near Tettenhall on 5 August 910. The allied forces of Mercia and Wessex met an army of Northumbrian Vikings in Mercia.

zh.s: 据《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》记载，泰滕霍尔战役于910年8月5日在泰滕霍尔附近发生，有时也称韦恩斯菲尔德战役或伍德内斯菲尔德战役。麦西亚和威塞克斯的联军在麦西亚与诺森布里亚维京军交战。

en.s: The Battle of Alhandic (Spanish: Batalla de Alhandic), also known as Zamora's trench Battle (Batalla del Foso de Zamora), was a battle that occurred on August 5, 939 in the city of Zamora, Spain. The battle occurred when the troops of Abd-ar-Rahman III assaulted the walls of Zamora. The defending troops were those loyal to Ramiro II of León, King of the Kingdom of Leon. The fighting was so bloody that the tide of the battle did not turn until the ditch surrounding the city walls was entirely filled with corpses. The troops of Aberraman III won the day and were able to seize the city of Zamora.

zh.s: 阿尔汉迪克战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Alhandic）又称萨莫拉壕沟战役（西班牙语：Batalla del Foso de Zamora），于939年8月5日在西班牙萨莫拉发生。阿卜杜·拉赫曼三世的军队进攻萨莫拉城墙，守军效忠于莱昂王国国王拉米罗二世。战斗极其惨烈，直到城墙周围的壕沟被尸体填满，战局才发生转变。阿卜杜·拉赫曼三世的军队获胜并攻占了萨莫拉。

en.s: The siege of Bari took place 1068–71, during the Middle Ages, when Norman forces, under the command of Robert Guiscard, laid siege to the city of Bari, a major stronghold of the Byzantines in Italy and the capital of the Catepanate of Italy, starting from August 5, 1068. Bari was captured on April 16, 1071 when Robert Guiscard entered the city, ending over five centuries of Byzantine presence in southern Italy.

zh.s: 1068年至1071年，中世纪时期，罗伯特·吉斯卡尔率领诺曼军队围攻巴里。巴里是拜占庭帝国在意大利的重要据点，也是意大利卡特帕诺区的首府。围城始于1068年8月5日。1071年4月16日，罗伯特·吉斯卡尔进入城市，攻占巴里，结束了拜占庭帝国在意大利南部长达五个多世纪的统治。

en.t: Henry I is crowned King of England in Westminster Abbey
en.s: Henry I (c. 1068 – 1 December 1135), also known as Henry Beauclerc, was King of England from 1100 to his death in 1135. He was the fourth son of William the Conqueror and was educated in Latin and the liberal arts. On William's death in 1087, Henry's elder brothers Robert Curthose and William Rufus inherited Normandy and England, respectively, thereby leaving Henry landless.

zh.t: 亨利一世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王
zh.s: 亨利一世（约1068年—1135年12月1日），也称“博学者亨利”，1100年至1135年去世前担任英格兰国王。他是征服者威廉的第四子，曾学习拉丁文和文科。威廉于1087年去世后，亨利的哥哥罗贝尔·柯索斯和威廉·鲁弗斯分别继承诺曼底和英格兰，亨利因此没有土地。

en.t: Richard I of England defeats Saladin in the battle of Jaffa, which enables him to conclude a favourable treaty for the crusaders
en.s: Richard I (8 September 1157 – 6 April 1199), known as Richard the Lionheart or Richard Cœur de Lion (Old Norman French: Quor de Lion) because of his reputation as a great military leader and warrior, was King of England from 1189 until his death in 1199. He also ruled as Duke of Normandy, Aquitaine, and Gascony; Lord of Cyprus; Count of Poitiers, Anjou, Maine, and Nantes; and was overlord of Brittany at various times during the same period.

zh.t: 英格兰国王理查一世在雅法战役中击败萨拉丁，因此得以为十字军争取到有利条约
zh.s: 理查一世（1157年9月8日—1199年4月6日）因其杰出的军事领导能力和战士声望，被称为“狮心王理查”或“狮心理查”（古诺曼法语：Quor de Lion）。他自1189年起担任英格兰国王，直至1199年去世。同一时期，他还统治诺曼底、阿基坦和加斯科涅，兼任塞浦路斯领主、普瓦捷伯爵、安茹伯爵、曼恩伯爵和南特伯爵，并曾在不同时期作为布列塔尼的宗主。

en.s: The battle of Frankfurt or the battle on the Nidda of 5 August 1246 was fought between two rival German kings, Henry Raspe, who had the support of Pope Innocent IV, and Conrad IV, the son of Emperor Frederick II. Henry was victorious.

zh.s: 1246年8月5日，法兰克福战役（又称尼达河战役）在两位敌对的德国国王之间爆发：海因里希·拉斯佩得到教宗英诺森四世支持，康拉德四世则是腓特烈二世皇帝之子。海因里希获胜。

en.s: The siege of Algeciras was the first of many sieges of the city by Christian forces in the lengthy period of the Spanish Reconquista. The siege, ordered by King Alfonso X of Castile also known as "el Sabio", was a fruitless military campaign initiated by the Kingdom of Castile with the objective of removing the Benimerins from Algeciras.

zh.s: 阿尔赫西拉斯围城战是西班牙收复失地运动期间，基督教军队对这座城市发动的多次围城战中的第一次。卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世下令发起这场围城，意在把马林王朝（Benimerin）势力赶出阿尔赫西拉斯，但行动最终无功而返。

en.t: First Scottish War of Independence: Sir John Stewart of Menteith, the pro-English Sheriff of Dumbarton, successfully manages to capture Sir William Wallace of Scotland, leading to Wallace's subsequent execution by hanging, evisceration, drawing and quartering, and beheading 18 days later
en.s: The First War of Scottish Independence was the first of a series of different wars between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland. It lasted from the English invasion of Scotland in 1296 until the de jure restoration of Scottish independence with the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton in 1328. De facto independence was established in 1314 AD following an English defeat at the Battle of Bannockburn.

zh.t: 第一次苏格兰独立战争：亲英派邓巴顿郡治安官、门蒂思的约翰·斯图尔特爵士成功擒获苏格兰的威廉·华莱士；华莱士18天后遭绞刑、开膛、肢解并斩首
zh.s: 第一次苏格兰独立战争是英格兰王国与苏格兰王国之间一系列战争中的第一场。战争从1296年英格兰入侵苏格兰开始，至1328年《爱丁堡—北安普敦条约》在法律上恢复苏格兰独立为止。公元1314年，英格兰在班诺克本战役中战败后，苏格兰事实上恢复独立。

en.s: The Battle of Otterburn took place according to Scottish sources on 5 August 1388, or 19 August according to English sources, as part of the continuing border skirmishes between the Scottish and English. The best remaining record of the battle is from Jean Froissart's Chronicles in which he claims to have interviewed veterans from both sides of the battle. His account is still regarded with some concern as details, such as the distance between Newcastle upon Tyne and Otterburn, are incorrect. The Scottish noble James, 2nd Earl of Douglas decided to lead a raid—one of a continuing series on both sides of the border—into English territory.

zh.s: 苏格兰资料称奥特本战役于1388年8月5日发生，英格兰资料则记为8月19日。战役是苏格兰与英格兰持续边境冲突的一部分。现存较完整的战役记载来自让·弗鲁瓦萨尔的《编年史》；他声称采访过双方老兵，但其记述仍受到质疑，例如纽卡斯尔和奥特本之间的距离就记错了。苏格兰贵族、第二代道格拉斯伯爵詹姆斯决定率军突袭英格兰领土，这是双方持续开展的一系列边境袭击之一。

en.s: The Battle of Brüx was fought on 5 August 1421 in North Bohemia during the Hussite Wars. The Hussite troops, led by Jan Želivský, were defeated by the Catholic Imperial forces of Frederick I of Saxony.

zh.s: 布吕克斯战役于1421年8月5日在胡斯战争期间于波希米亚北部发生。扬·热利夫斯基率领的胡斯派军队被萨克森的腓特烈一世统率的天主教帝国军队击败。

en.s: The naval battle of Ponza was fought in early August 1435, when the Duke of Milan dispatched the Genoese navy to relieve the besieged town of Gaeta, which was currently under threat from the King of Aragon.

zh.s: 1435年8月初，米兰公爵派热那亚舰队前往解围被围困的加埃塔。加埃塔当时正受到阿拉贡国王的威胁。

en.s: The Battle of Kletsk (Belarusian: Бітва пад Клецкам, Lithuanian: Klecko mūšis) was a battle fought on 5 August 1506 near Kletsk (now in Belarus), between the army of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, led by Court Marshall of Lithuania Michael Glinski, and the army of the Crimean Khanate, led by Fetih I Giray and Burnaş I Giray, sons of the Khan of Crimea, Meñli I Giray. The battle was one of the first and greatest Lithuanian victories over the Tatars.

zh.s: 克列茨克战役（白俄罗斯语：Бітва пад Клецкам；立陶宛语：Klecko mūšis）于1506年8月5日在克列茨克附近发生，交战双方是立陶宛大公国军队和克里米亚汗国军队。立陶宛军由宫廷元帅米哈伊尔·格林斯基率领；克里米亚汗国军队由克里米亚汗梅尼里一世·格莱的儿子费提赫一世·格莱和布尔纳什一世·格莱率领。这是立陶宛首次战胜鞑靼人，也是其最重要的胜利之一。

en.s: The Battle of Heiligerlee (5 August 1536) was a battle during the Guelders Wars, in which the Danish allies of Charles of Guelders, under command of Meindert van Ham, were defeated by Habsburg forces under Georg Schenck van Toutenburg. In 1534, the Danish Count's Feud spilled over into the Low Countries where the Guelders Wars were raging, when Habsburg supported Enno II, Count of East Frisia, ally of Christopher of Oldenburg and Charles, Duke of Guelders, supported Balthasar Oomkens von Esens, ally of Christian III of Denmark.

zh.s: 海利格莱战役于1536年8月5日爆发，是盖尔德战争中的一场战斗。查理·冯·埃格蒙特的丹麦盟军由迈因德特·范·哈姆率领，败于格奥尔格·申克·范·托滕堡指挥的哈布斯堡军队。1534年，丹麦伯爵战争蔓延至低地国家，当地正值盖尔德战争。哈布斯堡支持东弗里西亚伯爵恩诺二世；他是奥尔登堡的克里斯托弗的盟友。盖尔德公爵查理则支持巴尔塔萨·奥姆肯斯·冯·埃森斯；他是丹麦克里斯蒂安三世的盟友。

en.s: The Battle of Ponza (1552) was a naval battle that occurred near the Italian island of Ponza. The battle was fought between a Franco-Ottoman fleet under Dragut and a Spanish-Genoese fleet commanded by Andrea Doria. The latter were attempting to carry troops to Naples, but were diverted and lost seven galleys captured. The battle made it easier for the Ottoman fleet to raid the coasts of Sicily, Sardinia, and Italy for the next three years.

zh.s: 1552年蓬扎海战发生在意大利蓬扎岛附近，是德拉古特率领的法奥舰队与安德烈亚·多里亚指挥的西班牙—热那亚舰队交战。后者原本要把部队运往那不勒斯，却遭截击，7艘载兵桨帆船被俘。此战让奥斯曼舰队得以在接下来三年袭扰西西里、撒丁岛和意大利沿海。

en.t: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador: Established
en.s: St. John's is the capital and largest city of the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador. It is located on the eastern tip of the Avalon Peninsula on the island of Newfoundland. The city spans 446.04 square kilometres (172.22 sq mi) and is the easternmost city in North America (excluding Greenland).

zh.t: 纽芬兰与拉布拉多省圣约翰斯建城
zh.s: 圣约翰斯是加拿大纽芬兰与拉布拉多省的首府和最大城市，位于纽芬兰岛阿瓦隆半岛东端。城市面积为446.04平方公里（172.22平方英里），是北美最东端的城市（不包括格陵兰）。

en.s: The Battle of Traigh Ghruinneart or in Scottish Gaelic Blàr Tràigh Ghruineart or sometimes called the Battle of Gruinart Strand was a Scottish clan battle fought on 5 August 1598, on the Isle of Islay, in the Scottish Highlands. It was fought between the Clan Donald and Clan Maclean. A tràigh or stand is the flat area of land bordering a body of water, a beach, or shoreline.

zh.s: 格鲁因阿特海滩战役于1598年8月5日在苏格兰高地艾莱岛发生，是一场苏格兰氏族间的战斗。交战双方是唐纳德氏族和麦克莱恩氏族。苏格兰盖尔语中的“tràigh”指水体边缘的平坦地带，也可指海滩或海岸。

en.t: The Gowrie Conspiracy against King James VI of Scotland (later to become King James I of England) takes place at Gowrie House (Perth, Scotland)
en.s: John Ruthven, 3rd Earl of Gowrie (c. 1577 – 5 August 1600) was a Scottish nobleman who died in mysterious circumstances, referred to as the "Gowrie Conspiracy", in which he and/or his brother Alexander were attempting to kill or kidnap King James VI of Scotland for unknown purposes. The king's retinue killed both brothers during the attack, and the king survived.

zh.t: 针对苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世的戈里阴谋发生于苏格兰珀斯戈里宅邸
zh.s: 第三代戈里伯爵约翰·鲁思文（约1577—1600年8月5日）是苏格兰贵族，死因至今不明，这起事件因此被称为“戈里阴谋”。在事件中，他本人和／或其兄弟亚历山大试图以不明原因杀害或绑架苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世。国王的随从在冲突中杀死了兄弟二人，国王本人幸免于难。

en.s: The Capture of Daugavgriva by Swedish forces in July 1608 occurred during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). Daugavgrīva (Polish: Dynemund, Swedish: Dünamünde) was the first objective of the Swedish forces during the campaign of 1608, due to its location near Riga (of which it is a suburb today), and the fact that it could be used to block that city from the sea. When the Swedes, numbering 8000 troops and led by Joachim Frederick von Mansfeld, approached the fortress at Daugavgrīva, the Polish commander of the 130 strong garrison (with 40 cannons), Franciszek Białłozor, lacking in supplies and little hope of relief, decided to surrender.

zh.s: 1608年7月，瑞典军队攻占道加瓦格里瓦，发生在波瑞战争（1600—1611年）期间。道加瓦格里瓦（波兰语：Dynemund；瑞典语：Dünamünde）是瑞军1608年战役中的首要目标，因其靠近里加（如今是该市郊区），且可用来封锁里加的海上通道。约阿希姆·弗里德里希·冯·曼斯费尔德率领8,000名瑞典士兵逼近要塞时，波兰守军指挥官弗朗齐谢克·比亚沃佐尔手下仅有130人和40门大炮，补给不足，也几乎无望获得援军，因此决定投降。

en.s: The Battle of Wisternitz or Dolní Věstonice was fought on August 5, 1619 between a Moravian force under Friedrich von Tiefenbach (Teuffenbach) and an Austrian army under Dampierre. The battle was a Moravian victory. The battle is part of the Thirty Years' War. Budweis (České Budějovice) was one of the three towns which remained loyal to the Austrian emperor when Bohemia revolted. After the Austrian victory at Sablat, the Bohemians were forced to raise the siege of České Budějovice. On 15 June 1619, Hohenlohe retreated to Soběslav where he awaited reinforcement by count Heinrich Matthias von Thurn.

zh.s: 维斯特尼斯战役（又称多尔尼·维斯托尼采战役）于1619年8月5日发生，交战双方是弗里德里希·冯·蒂芬巴赫（又写作托伊芬巴赫）率领的摩拉维亚军队和丹皮埃尔率领的奥地利军队。摩拉维亚军队获胜。此战是三十年战争的一部分。波希米亚起义时，捷克布杰约维采是仍效忠奥地利皇帝的3座城镇之一。奥地利军队在萨布拉特获胜后，波希米亚军被迫解除对捷克布杰约维采的围困。1619年6月15日，霍恩洛厄撤退到索别斯拉夫，等待海因里希·马蒂亚斯·冯·图恩伯爵率军增援。

en.s: The Crossing of the Somme took place on 5 August 1636 during the Thirty Years' War and the Franco-Spanish War when units of the Spanish Army of Flanders and the Imperial Army under Thomas Francis, Prince of Carignano, lieutenant of the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand of Austria, crossed the Somme river near Bray-sur-Somme during its offensive in French territory.

zh.s: 1636年8月5日，三十年战争和法西战争期间，佛兰德军团的西班牙军队和卡里尼亚诺亲王托马斯·弗朗西斯率领的帝国军队渡过索姆河。托马斯·弗朗西斯是奥地利枢机亲王斐迪南的副将。两军在对法国领土发动攻势时，于布雷叙尔索姆附近渡河。

en.s: The Dano-Swedish War of 1658–1660 was a war between Denmark–Norway and Sweden, with the former backed by the Dutch Republic and Poland. It is known in Denmark as the Second Karl Gustav War (Danish: Anden Karl Gustav-krig), in Norway as Bjelkes Feud (Norwegian: Bjelkefeiden) in Sweden as Karl Gustav's Second Danish War (Swedish: Karl Gustavs andra danska krig), and in the Netherlands as the Swedish-Dutch War (Dutch: Zweeds-Nederlandse Oorlog).

zh.s: 1658—1660年的丹麦—瑞典战争发生在丹麦—挪威与瑞典之间，前者得到荷兰共和国和波兰支持。在丹麦，这场战争称为第二次卡尔·古斯塔夫战争（丹麦语：Anden Karl Gustav-krig）；在挪威称为比耶尔克争端（挪威语：Bjelkefeiden）；在瑞典称为卡尔·古斯塔夫第二次丹麦战争（瑞典语：Karl Gustavs andra danska krig）；在荷兰则称为瑞荷战争（荷兰语：Zweeds-Nederlandse Oorlog）。

en.s: The Lachine massacre, part of the Beaver Wars, occurred when 1,500 Mohawk warriors attacked by surprise the small, 375-inhabitant, settlement of Lachine, New France at the lower end of Montreal Island on the morning of August 5, 1689. The attack was precipitated by growing Iroquois dissatisfaction with the increased French incursions into their territory, and was encouraged by the settlers of New England as a way to leverage power against New France during King William's War. In their attack, the Mohawk destroyed a substantial portion of the Lachine settlement by fire and killed or captured numerous inhabitants, although historic sources have varied widely in estimates of the number killed, from 24 to 250.

zh.s: 拉欣屠杀是海狸战争的一部分。1689年8月5日清晨，1,500名莫霍克战士突袭新法兰西拉欣定居点，当时当地只有375名居民。袭击发生在蒙特利尔岛南部。易洛魁人对法国人不断侵入其领地日益不满，是袭击的导火索；新英格兰殖民者也鼓励这次行动，以便在威廉王战争期间增强对新法兰西的影响力。莫霍克人纵火摧毁了拉欣定居点的大部分地区，并杀死或俘虏许多居民。历史资料对死亡人数的估计差异很大，从24人到250人不等。

en.s: The Battle of Petrovaradin also known as the Battle of Peterwardein, took place on 5 August 1716 during the Austro-Turkish War when the Ottoman army besieged the Habsburg-controlled fortress of Petrovaradin on the Military Frontier of the Habsburg monarchy (today Novi Sad, Vojvodina, Serbia). The Ottomans attempted to capture Petrovaradin, the so-called Gibraltar on the Danube, but experienced a great defeat by an army half the size of their own, similar to the defeat they had experienced in 1697 at the Battle of Zenta.

zh.s: 彼得罗瓦拉丁战役又称彼得瓦尔丁战役，于1716年8月5日爆发，属于奥土战争的一部分。当时奥斯曼军队围攻哈布斯堡王朝军事边境区内由哈布斯堡控制的彼得罗瓦拉丁要塞（今塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那省诺维萨德）。奥斯曼军队试图攻占这座被称为“多瑙河上的直布罗陀”的要塞，却被人数只有己方一半的军队大败；奥斯曼军队此前也曾在1697年的曾塔战役中遭遇类似惨败。

en.s: The Battle of Bushy Run was fought on August 5-6, 1763, in western Pennsylvania, between a British column under the command of Colonel Henry Bouquet and a combined force of Delaware, Shawnee, Mingo, and Huron warriors. This action occurred during Pontiac's Rebellion. Though the British suffered serious losses, they routed the tribesmen and successfully relieved the garrison of Fort Pitt.

zh.s: 布希朗战役于1763年8月5日至6日在宾夕法尼亚州西部发生。亨利·布凯上校率领的英国纵队与特拉华人、肖尼人、明戈人和休伦人组成的联军交战。战役发生在庞蒂亚克起义期间。尽管英军损失惨重，仍击溃了原住民战士，并成功解救了皮特堡守军。

en.t: First Partition of Poland: The representatives of Austria, Prussia, and Russia sign three bilateral conventions condemning the "anarchy" of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and imputing to the three powers "ancient and legitimate rights" to the territories of the Commonwealth. The conventions allow each of the three great powers to annex a part of the Commonwealth, which they proceed to do over the course of the following two months
en.s: The First Partition of Poland took place in 1772 as the first of three partitions that eventually ended the existence of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth by 1795. The growth of power in the Russian Empire threatened the Kingdom of Prussia and the Habsburg monarchy and was the primary motive behind the First Partition.

zh.t: 波兰第一次瓜分：奥地利、普鲁士和俄罗斯代表签署三份双边公约，谴责波兰立陶宛联邦的“无政府状态”，并声称三国对联邦领土拥有“古老且正当的权利”。公约允许三个大国各自吞并联邦的一部分，随后两个月内它们便付诸行动
zh.s: 波兰第一次瓜分发生于1772年，是三次瓜分中的第一次，最终导致波兰立陶宛联邦于1795年覆亡。俄罗斯帝国日益强大，对普鲁士王国和哈布斯堡君主国构成威胁，这是第一次瓜分的主要动机。

en.t: Battle of the House in the Horseshoe
en.s: The Battle of the House in the Horseshoe was a minor engagement during the American Revolution between loyalist militia under the command of David Fanning and patriot militia under the command of Phillip Alston, the owner of the House in the Horseshoe. The battle, which took place on either July 29 or August 5, 1781 (with July 29 being the most accepted date), ended in a victory for the loyalists. The surrender terms between the combatants were negotiated by Alston's wife on behalf of the patriots, and by Fanning for the loyalists.

zh.s: 马蹄屋战役是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模交战，双方分别是戴维·范宁指挥的效忠派民兵，以及马蹄屋屋主菲利普·奥尔斯顿指挥的爱国派民兵。战斗发生于1781年7月29日或8月5日（普遍接受的日期是7月29日），以效忠派获胜告终。双方的投降条款由奥尔斯顿的妻子代表爱国派、范宁代表效忠派进行协商。

en.s: The Battle of Dogger Bank was a fleet action fought in the North Sea on 5 August 1781 during the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War. It occurred between a British fleet under Vice-Admiral of the Blue Sir Hyde Parker and a Dutch squadron under Schout-bij-nacht Johan Zoutman, both of which were escorting convoys.

zh.s: 多格滩海战是第四次英荷战争期间于1781年8月5日在北海进行的一场舰队战。英国舰队由蓝旗副海军上将海德·帕克爵士率领，荷兰分舰队由海军少将约翰·佐特曼率领，双方当时都在为护航船队护航。

en.s: The Battle of Castiglione saw the French Army of Italy under General Napoleon Bonaparte attack an army of Habsburg Austria led by Feldmarschall Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser on 5 August 1796. The outnumbered Austrians were defeated and driven back along a line of hills to the river crossing at Borghetto, where they retired beyond the Mincio River. The town of Castiglione delle Stiviere is located 10 kilometres (6 mi) south of Lake Garda in northern Italy. This battle was one of four famous victories won by Bonaparte during the War of the First Coalition, part of the Wars of the French Revolution.

zh.s: 1796年8月5日，拿破仑·波拿巴将军率领的法国意大利军团进攻由达戈贝特·西格蒙德·冯·武姆泽元帅统率的哈布斯堡奥地利军队。人数较少的奥军战败，沿山丘一线退至博尔盖托渡口，随后撤到明乔河对岸。卡斯蒂廖内·德莱·斯蒂维耶雷镇位于意大利北部、加尔达湖南面约10公里处。这是波拿巴在第一次反法同盟战争中的四场著名胜利之一；该战争属于法国大革命战争。

en.s: The Battle of Brownstown was an early skirmish in the War of 1812. Although the United States military outnumbered the forces of Tecumseh's Confederacy 8 to 1, they lost the engagement and suffered substantial losses while Tecumseh's forces were almost completely untouched. The skirmish occurred near Brownstown, a Wyandot village south of Fort Detroit on Brownstown creek. Brownstown was also known as "Sindathon's Village".

zh.s: 布朗斯敦之战是1812年战争初期的一场小规模交战。尽管美军人数以8比1占优，面对特库姆塞联盟军队时仍然战败并损失惨重，而特库姆塞一方几乎毫发无损。交战地点在布朗斯敦溪附近的怀恩多特人村落布朗斯敦，位于底特律堡以南；该村也称“辛达松村”。

en.s: The Capture of HMS Dominica was a notable single-ship action that occurred on 5 August 1813 off the Bermudas during the War of 1812. American privateer Decatur and the Royal Navy warship Dominica engaged in a fierce contest that ended with the capture of the British ship after a long battle.

zh.s: “多米尼加”号被俘是1812年战争期间一次著名的单舰海战，于1813年8月5日在百慕大附近发生。美国私掠船“迪凯特”号与英国皇家海军军舰“多米尼加”号激战多时，最终俘获了这艘英国军舰。

en.s: The Battle of Matrand (Norwegian: Slaget ved Matrand) was a military battle on 5 August 1814 between Norwegian and Swedish forces as part of the Swedish-Norwegian War of 1814. The battle took place near the villages of Matrand and Skotterud in Eidskog. It was the bloodiest battle of the entire war, in which the Swedes lost over 340 men, of which 270 were captured; the Norwegians lost around 50 men with 60 wounded and 36 captured.

zh.s: 马特兰战役（挪威语：Slaget ved Matrand）于1814年8月5日爆发，是1814年瑞典—挪威战争期间挪威与瑞典军队之间的一场战斗。战斗发生在埃兹科格的马特兰和斯科特鲁德村附近，是整场战争中伤亡最惨重的一战。瑞典军队损失超过340人，其中270人被俘；挪威军队约有50人阵亡，60人受伤，36人被俘。

Jonathan Jennings, the longtime U.S. delegate representing the Indiana Territory's at-large congressional district and former president of the Indiana constitutional convention, defeated the incumbent territorial governor Thomas Posey. This was the first gubernatorial election held following ratification of the Constitution of Indiana.

en.s: The 1816 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on August 5, 1816, to elect the governor of Kentucky. George Madison, Kentucky's longtime auditor of public accounts and a veteran of three wars, was elected without opposition after former state senator James Johnson withdrew from the contest. Madison received 47,442 votes. The election occurred in a state dominated by the Democratic-Republican Party, and both Madison and Johnson belonged to that broad political tradition.

The U.S. representative from Indiana's at-large congressional district William Hendricks was elected virtually without opposition. This was the only unanimous Indiana gubernatorial election and the last before the revival of party politics following the 1824 United States presidential election. The incumbent governor of Indiana Jonathan Jennings was ineligible for re-election due to term limits established by the Constitution of Indiana.

en.s: The Battle of Szőreg was a battle in the Hungarian Revolution of 1848, fought on 5 August 1849 at Szőreg, Hungary. The Hungarian troops, led by Henryk Dembiński, lost the battle against the Emperor’s troops, led by Haynau. Even though the Hungarian losses were relatively small in number, the defeat deeply affected the Hungarians' organisation and morale.

zh.s: 瑟勒格战役是1848年匈牙利革命期间的一场战斗，于1849年8月5日在匈牙利瑟勒格发生。亨里克·登宾斯基率领的匈牙利军队被海瑙率领的皇帝军队击败。尽管匈牙利方面损失人数相对较少，这场失败仍严重打击了匈牙利军队的组织和士气。

en.t: 1850–51 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: States held the 1850–51 United States House of Representatives elections between August 5, 1850, and November 4, 1851, during President Millard Fillmore's term. Each state set a date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 32nd United States Congress convened on December 1, 1851. Thirty-one states held elections, for 233 House seats.

All candidates were staunch secessionists, promising to wage vigorous war upon the North in cooperation with Confederate authorities.

The Act, motivated by the need to fund the Civil War, imposed an income tax to be "levied, collected, and paid, upon the annual income of every person residing in the United States, whether such income is derived from any kind of property, or from any profession, trade, employment, or vocation carried on in the United States or elsewhere, or from any other source whatever".

en.s: The Battle of Baton Rouge was a ground and naval battle in the American Civil War fought in East Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana, on August 5, 1862. The Union victory halted Confederate attempts to recapture the capital city of Louisiana.

zh.s: 巴吞鲁日战役于1862年8月5日在路易斯安那州东巴吞鲁日堂区发生，是美国内战期间的一场陆战和海战。联邦军获胜，阻止了邦联军重新夺回路易斯安那州首府的企图。

en.s: The Battle of Depułtycze, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on August 5, 1863, near the village of Depułtycze Królewskie, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A Polish insurgent unit clashed with a detachment of the Imperial Russian Army, which was sent there from Krasnystaw. The battle began at 10:30 a.m., and lasted several hours, ending in Polish victory.

zh.s: 德普乌蒂切战役是波兰一月起义期间发生的多场冲突之一，于1863年8月5日在德普乌蒂切·克鲁莱夫斯基村附近爆发。当时该地属于俄罗斯控制的波兰会议王国。一支波兰起义军与一支从克拉斯内斯塔夫派来的俄罗斯帝国军队分遣队交战。战斗于上午10时30分开始，持续数小时，最终以波兰军队获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Mobile Bay of August 5, 1864 was an engagement of the American Civil War in which a Federal fleet commanded by Rear Admiral David G. Farragut, assisted by a contingent of soldiers, attacked a smaller Confederate fleet led by Admiral Franklin Buchanan and three forts that guarded the entrance to Mobile Bay. The battle was marked by Farragut's seemingly rash but successful run through a minefield that had just claimed one of his ironclad monitors, enabling his fleet to get beyond the range of the shore-based guns. This was followed by a reduction of the Confederate fleet to a single vessel, ironclad CSS Tennessee.

zh.s: 1864年8月5日的莫比尔湾战役是美国内战中的一场海战。大卫·G·法拉格特海军少将率领联邦舰队，在一支陆军部队协助下，攻击富兰克林·布坎南海军上将率领的规模较小的邦联舰队，以及守卫莫比尔湾入口的3座堡垒。法拉格特不顾看似鲁莽的风险，成功率舰队穿越刚刚击沉一艘联邦铁甲舰的水雷区，使舰队得以驶出岸炮射程。此后，邦联舰队只剩下一艘铁甲舰“田纳西”号。

en.s: The Battle of Utoy Creek was fought August 5–7, 1864, during the Atlanta campaign of the American Civil War. Maj. Gen. William T. Sherman's Union armies had partially encircled the city of Atlanta, Georgia, which was being held by Confederate forces under the command of General John Bell Hood. Sherman had at this point adopted a strategy of attacking the railroad lines into Atlanta, hoping to cut off his enemies' supplies.

zh.s: 尤托伊溪战役于1864年8月5日至7日在美国内战亚特兰大战役期间进行。威廉·T·谢尔曼少将率领的联邦军部分包围了佐治亚州亚特兰大市。该市由约翰·贝尔·胡德将军率领的邦联军守卫。谢尔曼此时采取了攻击通往亚特兰大的铁路线路的策略，希望切断敌军补给。

en.s: The Battle of Maglaj was a military engagement between Austria-Hungary and the Ottoman Empire that took place on 3–5 August 1878 as part of the Austro-Hungarian military campaign in Bosnia and Herzegovina in the Bosnian vilayet for control of the strategic town of Maglaj. The Austro-Hungarian expeditionary Force was surprised by the stiff resistance of the Bosnian Muslims when crossing the Bosnia River near the city, and managed to gain control of the area only after a secondary combat strike.

zh.s: 马格拉伊战役是奥匈帝国与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场军事交战，于1878年8月3日至5日爆发，是奥匈帝国在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那地区（当时属波斯尼亚维拉耶）发动军事行动、争夺战略城镇马格拉伊的一部分。奥匈远征军在城附近渡过波斯纳河时，遭到波斯尼亚穆斯林的顽强抵抗，出乎意料；他们在发动第二次战斗打击后才控制该地区。

en.s: The Battle of Kafr El Dawwar was a conflict during the Anglo-Egyptian War near Kafr El Dawwar, Egypt. The battle took place between an Egyptian army, headed by Ahmed ‘Urabi, and British forces headed by Sir Archibald Alison. As a result, the British abandoned any hope they may have had of reaching Cairo from the north, and shifted their base of operations to Ismailia instead.

zh.s: 卡夫尔达瓦尔之战是英埃战争期间在埃及卡夫尔达瓦尔附近发生的一场战斗，交战双方是艾哈迈德·乌拉比率领的埃及军队和阿奇博尔德·艾利森爵士率领的英军。战后，英军放弃从北面进军开罗的希望，将作战基地转移到了伊斯梅利亚。

en.t: Standard Oil Company of New Jersey, today known as ExxonMobil, is established officially. The company would later grow to become the holder of all Standard Oil companies and the entity at the center of the breakup of Standard Oil
en.s: Standard Oil Company was a corporate trust in the petroleum industry that existed from 1882 to 1911. The origins of the trust lay in the operations of the Standard Oil Company (Ohio), which was founded in 1870 by John D. Rockefeller. The trust was born on January 2, 1882, when a group of 41 investors signed the Standard Oil Trust Agreement which pooled their securities of 40 companies into a single holding agency managed by nine trustees.

zh.s: 标准石油公司是1882年至1911年间石油行业的一家企业托拉斯。该托拉斯源自俄亥俄标准石油公司的业务；后者由约翰·D·洛克菲勒于1870年创立。1882年1月2日，41名投资者签署《标准石油托拉斯协议》，将40家公司的证券合并交由一个由九名受托人管理的控股机构，托拉斯由此成立。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Awarua electorate on 5 August 1897, for the seat vacated by Joseph Ward, which he had held since 1887. Despite having had to resign due to bankruptcy, he exploited a legal loophole and was re-elected to the 13th New Zealand Parliament.

zh.s: 奥瓦鲁瓦选区于1897年8月5日举行补选，以填补约瑟夫·沃德辞职后空出的席位。沃德自1887年起担任该选区议员。尽管他因破产而必须辞职，仍利用法律漏洞重新当选，进入新西兰第13届议会。

en.s: The Battle of Beicang (Chinese: 北倉之戰), also rendered as the Battle of Peitsang, was fought August 5, 1900 during the Boxer Rebellion, between the Eight Nation Alliance and the Chinese Qing dynasty army. The Chinese army was forced out of its prepared entrenchments and retreated to Yangcun. The Japanese contingent led the Alliance attack; with contingents also being present from Russia, Britain, America and France.

zh.s: 北仓战役（中文：北倉之戰，又译“北仓之战”）于1900年8月5日在义和团运动期间爆发，交战双方是八国联军和清军。清军被迫撤出预设的壕沟阵地，退往杨村。联军进攻由日军分队主导，俄国、英国、美国和法国也派有部队参战。

en.s: The Battle of Romani was the last ground attack of the Central Powers on the Suez Canal at the beginning of the Sinai and Palestine campaign during the First World War. The battle was fought between 3 and 5 August 1916 near the Egyptian town of Romani and the site of ancient Pelusium on the Sinai Peninsula, 23 mi (37 km) east of the Suez Canal.

zh.s: 罗马尼战役是第一次世界大战期间西奈及巴勒斯坦战役初期，同盟国对苏伊士运河发动的最后一次地面进攻。战斗于1916年8月3日至5日在埃及城镇罗马尼附近、古城佩卢西翁遗址一带进行，地点位于西奈半岛，距苏伊士运河以东23英里（37公里）。

en.s: The Battle of Kilmallock took place between 25 July and 5 August 1922 in County Limerick. It was one of the largest engagements of the Irish Civil War. It consisted of ten days of fighting in the countryside round Kilmallock in County Limerick, in which Irish Free State Army forces, advancing south from Limerick city, found their path blocked by anti-Treaty IRA troops, dug into a number of villages at Bruff, Bruree and Patrickswell. The fighting ended with the retreat of the anti-Treaty fighters and the occupation of Kilmallock by Free State forces.

zh.s: 基尔马洛克战役于1922年7月25日至8月5日在利默里克郡进行，是爱尔兰内战中规模最大的交战之一。战斗持续10天，发生在基尔马洛克周边乡村。爱尔兰自由邦军从利默里克市向南推进，却遭到反条约派爱尔兰共和军阻挡；这些部队据守布拉夫、布鲁里和帕特里克斯韦尔等村庄。最终，反条约派部队撤退，自由邦军占领基尔马洛克。

en.s: Plaid Cymru (English: plyde KUM-ree; Welsh: [plaid ˈkəmrɨ̞]; lit. 'Party of Wales', officially Plaid Cymru – the Party of Wales, and often referred to simply as Plaid) is a centre-left to left-wing Welsh nationalist political party in Wales, that supports Welsh independence from the United Kingdom. It campaigns on a platform of social democracy and civic nationalism.

zh.t: 威尔士党成立，旨在传播当时濒临消亡的威尔士语
zh.s: 威尔士党（英语读音：plyde KUM-ree；威尔士语：[plaid ˈkəmrɨ̞]；字面意思为“威尔士党”；正式名称为Plaid Cymru – the Party of Wales，常简称Plaid）是威尔士的中间偏左至左翼威尔士民族主义政党，支持威尔士脱离英国独立。该党以社会民主主义和公民民族主义为纲领开展活动。

zh.s: “十三朵玫瑰”（Las Trece Rosas）是13名年轻女性组成的团体。西班牙内战刚结束不久，佛朗哥政权的行刑队于1939年8月5日将她们处决。她们是统一社会主义青年团成员。此次处决属于大规模处决行动“八月清洗”（saca de agosto）的一部分；该行动还处决了43名年轻男性，其中包括一名14岁少年。

en.s: Battle of Ceber took place overnight of August 4 and August 5, 1944 in the village of Ceber in the Holy Cross Mountains (Świętokrzyskie). A battalion of Polish partisans of the Home Army's 2nd Legions' Infantry Regiment led by Capt. Michał Mandziara (nom de guerre Siwy) assaulted a German garrison of the village, took it by surprise and annihilated it after a brief encounter. The battle was part of a larger Operation Tempest. The Polish unit numbered 84 men (entire 3rd battalion of the 2nd Legions' Infantry Regiment) and was organised into two platoons led by second lieutenant Dionizy Mędrzycki (nom de guerre Reder) and second lieutenant Witold Józefowski (nom de guerre Miś).

en.s: The 1949 Ambato earthquake was the largest earthquake in the Western Hemisphere in more than five years. On August 5, 1949, it struck Ecuador's Tungurahua Province southeast of its capital Ambato and killed 5,050 people. Measuring 6.8 on the Richter scale it originated from a hypocenter 40 km (25 mi) beneath the surface. The nearby villages of Guano, Patate, Pelileo, and Pillaro were destroyed, and the city of Ambato suffered heavy damage. The earthquake flattened entire buildings, and subsequent landslides caused damage throughout the Tungurahua, Chimborazo, and Cotopaxi Provinces. It disrupted water mains and communication lines and opened a fissure into which the small town of Libertad sank.

en.s: The Mann Gulch fire was a wildfire reported on August 5, 1949 in a gulch located along the upper Missouri River in the Gates of the Mountains Wilderness, Helena National Forest, in the state of Montana in the United States. en.s: The Partial Test Ban Treaty (PTBT), formally known as the 1963 Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests in the Atmosphere, in Outer Space and Under Water, prohibited all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. It is also abbreviated as the Limited Test Ban Treaty (LTBT) and Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (NTBT), though the latter may also refer to the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), which succeeded the PTBT for ratifying parties. Negotiations initially focused on a comprehensive ban, but that was abandoned because of technical questions surrounding the detection of underground tests and Soviet concerns over the intrusiveness of proposed verification methods. The impetus for the test ban was provided by rising public anxiety over the magnitude of nuclear tests, particularly tests of new thermonuclear weapons (hydrogen bombs), and the resulting nuclear fallout. A test ban was also seen as a means of slowing nuclear proliferation and the nuclear arms race. Though the PTBT did not halt proliferation or the arms race, its enactment did coincide with a substantial decline in the concentration of radioactive particles in the atmosphere. The PTBT was signed by the governments of the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States in Moscow on 5 August 1963 before it was opened for signature by other countries.

zh.s: 《部分禁止核试验条约》（PTBT）的正式名称为《1963年禁止在大气层、外层空间和水下进行核武器试验条约》。该条约禁止所有核武器试爆，地下试验除外。它也简称《有限禁止核试验条约》（LTBT）或《禁止核试验条约》（NTBT）；不过，后一个简称也可能指后来由缔约方批准的《全面禁止核试验条约》（CTBT）。谈判最初以全面禁止核试验为目标，但由于地下试验的监测存在技术问题，以及苏联担心拟议的核查方式过于侵入，全面禁试方案最终被放弃。推动禁试的原因包括公众对核试验规模日益增长的担忧，尤其是新型热核武器（氢弹）试验及其造成的放射性沉降。禁试也被视为减缓核扩散和军备竞赛的一种方式。PTBT虽未能阻止核扩散或军备竞赛，但条约生效后，大气中的放射性粒子浓度确实大幅下降。1963年8月5日，苏联、英国和美国政府在莫斯科签署了该条约，随后开放给其他国家签署。

en.s: The 2000 Belgian Supercup was a football match between the winners of the previous season's 1999–2000 Belgian First Division and 1999–2000 Belgian Cup competitions: cup winners Genk and league champions Anderlecht. The match was played on 5 August 2000 at the ground of the league winners Anderlecht, Constant Vanden Stock Stadium. Prior to the game, the clubs agreed to allow more substitutions, leading to Anderlecht making six changes at halftime and seven in total during the game.

en.s: A suicide bomber detonated a car bomb outside the lobby of the JW Marriott Jakarta hotel on 5 August 2003, killing 12 people and injuring 150. Those killed included 11 Indonesians and one Dutch national. The hotel was viewed as a Western symbol, and had been used by the United States embassy for various events. The hotel was closed for five weeks and reopened to the public on 8 September 2003.

zh.s: 2003年8月5日，一名自杀式袭击者在雅加达JW万豪酒店大堂外引爆汽车炸弹，造成12人死亡、150人受伤。死者包括11名印度尼西亚人和1名荷兰人。该酒店被视为西方象征，美国使馆也曾在此举办多场活动。酒店关闭五周后，于2003年9月8日重新对公众开放。

He was defeated in the primary election by businessman Don Williamson and County Commissioner Floyd Clack, both of whom advanced to the general election.

en.s: CIMIC House was the British Army-led Multi-National Division (South-East)'s centre of Civil-Military Co-operation (CIMIC) activities in the Iraqi town of Al Amarah during the 2003–2011 occupation of Iraq. It was situated in the former residence of the Ba'ath Party governor of Maysan province. It was before the Battle of Maysan al Amarah (2006) Determined to capture the strong point, militiamen of the Shia Mahdi Army launched sustained attacks on the British positions at CIMIC House and the neighbouring Pink Palace, the seat of local government, beginning on 5 August 2004.

zh.s: CIMIC大楼是英军领导的东南多国师在伊拉克占领时期于阿马拉设立的军民合作中心，所在地原是复兴党省长官邸。这场战斗发生在2006年米桑省阿马拉战役之前。什叶派迈赫迪军民兵试图夺取这一据点，从2004年8月5日起持续攻击CIMIC大楼内的英军阵地，以及相邻的地方政府所在地“粉红宫”。

en.s: The 2007 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield sponsored by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 85th staging of the FA Community Shield, an annual football match played between the reigning Premier League champions and FA Cup winners. The match was played on 5 August 2007 between 2006–07 FA Premier League champions Manchester United and 2006–07 FA Cup winners Chelsea, who beat United in the final.

zh.s: 2007年英格兰社区盾杯（因赞助也称“麦当劳赞助的英格兰社区盾杯”）是第85届英格兰社区盾杯。这项年度足球赛事由卫冕英超冠军对阵足总杯冠军。比赛于2007年8月5日举行，对阵双方是2006—07赛季英超冠军曼联和足总杯冠军切尔西；切尔西曾在足总杯决赛中击败曼联。

en.s: The 2009 Suruga Bank Championship (Japanese: スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2009; Spanish: Copa Suruga Bank 2009) was a match between the winners of the previous season's J. League Cup and the Copa Sudamericana. It was contested by the 2008 J. League Cup winner Japanese club Oita Trinita and the 2008 Copa Sudamericana champion Brazilian club Internacional. zh.s: 2009年骏河银行锦标赛由上一赛季日本联赛杯冠军与南美杯冠军交锋。参赛双方是2008年日本联赛杯冠军大分三神和2008年南美杯冠军巴西国际。巴西国际以2比1获胜，首次夺得骏河银行锦标赛；这也是该队第五个国际赛事冠军。

en.s: On 5 August 2010, ten members of International Assistance Mission (IAM) Nuristan Eye Camp team were killed in Kuran wa Munjan District of Badakhshan Province in Afghanistan. The team was attacked as it was returning from Nuristan to Kabul. One team member was spared, the rest of the team were killed immediately. Those killed were six Americans, two Afghans, one Briton and one German. The identity of the attackers is unknown. When news of the killings broke, both Hizb-e Islami and the Taliban initially claimed responsibility for the attack, accusing the doctors of proselytism and spying.

zh.s: 2010年8月5日，国际援助团（IAM）努里斯坦眼科医疗队的10名成员在阿富汗巴达赫尚省库兰和穆詹县遇害。医疗队从努里斯坦返回喀布尔途中遭到袭击。一名队员幸免，其余队员当场遇害。死者中有6名美国人、2名阿富汗人、1名英国人和1名德国人。袭击者身份不明。消息传出后，伊斯兰党和塔利班最初都声称对此负责，并指控医生从事传教和间谍活动。

en.s: A mining accident began on 5 August 2010 with a cave-in at the San José copper–gold mine in the Atacama Desert, 45 kilometers (28 mi) north of the regional capital of Copiapó, in northern Chile. Thirty-three men were trapped 700 meters (2,300 ft) underground and 5 kilometers (3 mi) from the mine's entrance. They were all rescued 69 days later.

zh.s: 2010年8月5日，阿塔卡马沙漠中的圣何塞铜金矿发生塌方，智利北部科皮亚波以北45公里（28英里）处的这座矿场由此发生矿难。33名矿工被困在地下700米（2,300英尺）处，距矿井入口5公里（3英里）。69天后，他们全部获救。

en.s: La Gran Cruzada (2012) (Spanish for "The Great Crusade") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on August 5, 2012 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event of the show was the eponymous Gran Cruzada tournament, a 30-man Battle Royal with the winner being named the number one contender for the IWRG Rey del Ring Championship and would receive a match against Rey del Ring Champion Oficial Factor at a later date. The Gran Cruzada was won by Hijo de Pirata Morgan, lastly eliminating El Hijo de L.A.

zh.s: 《大远征》（La Gran Cruzada，西班牙语意为“大远征”）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）主办的年度大型赛事，于2012年8月5日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是同名“大远征”锦标赛，一场30人皇家大战。获胜者将成为IWRG“擂台之王”冠军赛的头号挑战者，并在之后挑战卫冕冠军奥菲西尔·法克托。莫根海盗之子最终赢得锦标赛，最后淘汰了洛杉矶之子。

en.s: The Wisconsin Sikh temple shooting was a mass shooting that took place at the gurdwara (Sikh temple) in Oak Creek, Wisconsin, on August 5, 2012, when 40-year-old Wade Michael Page fatally shot six people and wounded four others. A seventh victim died of his wounds in 2020. Page committed suicide by shooting himself in the head. Page was an American white supremacist and Army veteran from Cudahy, Wisconsin.

zh.s: 2012年8月5日，威斯康星州奥克克里克市的锡克教礼拜堂发生大规模枪击案。40岁的韦德·迈克尔·佩奇开枪打死6人、打伤4人；第7名受害者于2020年因伤去世。佩奇随后朝自己头部开枪自杀。他是来自威斯康星州卡迪希市的白人至上主义者，曾在美国陆军服役。

en.s: The elections to the next vice president of India, were held on 5 August 2017. The announcement was made by the Election Commission of India. Rajya Sabha Secretary-General Shumsher K. Sheriff served as the Returning Officer for the 15th vice presidential election. Vice President Mohammad Hamid Ansari, completed his second term on 10 August 2017.

en.s: The 2017 Johan Cruyff Shield was the 22nd edition of the Johan Cruyff Shield (Dutch: Johan Cruijff Schaal), an annual Dutch football match played between the winners of the previous season's Eredivisie and KNVB Cup. The match was contested by Feyenoord, champions of the 2016–17 Eredivisie, and Vitesse, winners of the 2016–17 KNVB Cup. It was held at the De Kuip in Rotterdam on 5 August 2017.

zh.s: 2017年约翰·克鲁伊夫盾杯（荷兰语：Johan Cruijff Schaal）是该赛事第22届。这项年度荷兰足球赛事由上赛季荷甲冠军对阵荷兰杯冠军。本届对阵双方是2016—17赛季荷甲冠军费耶诺德和荷兰杯冠军维特斯。比赛于2017年8月5日在鹿特丹的德奎普球场举行。

en.s: The 2017 DFL-Supercup was the eighth edition of the German super cup under the name DFL-Supercup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. The match was played on 5 August 2017. The DFL-Supercup featured Borussia Dortmund, the winners of the 2016–17 DFB-Pokal, and Bayern Munich, the winners of the 2016–17 Bundesliga and holders of the competition.

zh.s: 2017年德国超级杯是以“DFL-Supercup”之名举办的第八届德国超级杯。这项年度足球赛事由上赛季德甲冠军对阵德国足协杯冠军。比赛于2017年8月5日举行，对阵双方是2016—17赛季德国足协杯冠军多特蒙德，以及德甲冠军、卫冕赛事冠军拜仁慕尼黑。

en.s: The 2017 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira was the 39th edition of the Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira. It took place on 5 August 2017 and featured the winners of the 2016–17 Primeira Liga and 2016–17 Taça de Portugal, Benfica, and the runners-up of the Taça de Portugal, Vitória de Guimarães. Benfica won their second consecutive Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira for the first time and seventh overall.

zh.t: 2017年坎迪杜·德·奥利维拉超级杯
zh.s: 2017年坎迪杜·德·奥利维拉超级杯是该赛事第39届，于2017年8月5日举行。对阵双方是2016—17赛季葡超和葡萄牙杯冠军本菲卡，以及葡萄牙杯亚军吉马良斯。凭借这场胜利，本菲卡首次实现该赛事两连冠，累计第七次夺冠。

en.s: The 2018 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield supported by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 96th FA Community Shield, an annual football match played between the title holders of the Premier League and FA Cup. It was contested by Manchester City, champions of the 2017–18 Premier League, and Chelsea, winners of the 2017–18 FA Cup, at Wembley Stadium in London on 5 August 2018.

zh.s: 2018年英格兰社区盾杯（因赞助也称“麦当劳赞助的英格兰社区盾杯”）是第96届英格兰社区盾杯。这项年度足球赛事由英超联赛冠军对阵足总杯冠军。本届比赛于2018年8月5日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是2017—18赛季英超冠军曼彻斯特城和足总杯冠军切尔西。

en.s: The 2018 Nagano gubernatorial election was held on 5 August 2018 to elect the next governor of Nagano (長野県, Nagano-ken), a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu island. Incumbent Governor Shuichi Abe was re-elected for a third term, defeating Chuichi Kanai with 85.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 2018年长野县知事选举于2018年8月5日举行，以选出长野县（长野県）下一任知事。长野县位于日本本州中部地区。时任知事阿部守一成功连任，开启第三个任期；他击败金井忠一，得票率为85.14%。

en.s: The 2018 Turkish Super Cup (Turkish: TFF Süper Kupa) was the 45th edition of the Turkish Super Cup since its establishment as Presidential Cup in 1966, the annual Turkish football season-opening match contested by the winners of the previous season's top league and cup competitions (or cup runner-up in case the league- and cup-winning club is the same).

zh.s: 2018年土耳其超级杯是土耳其超级杯自1966年以“总统杯”之名创办以来的第45届赛事。这项年度足球赛在赛季开始前举行，由上赛季联赛和土耳其杯冠军交锋；若同一支球队包揽两项冠军，则由土耳其杯亚军参赛。2018年8月5日，土超冠军加拉塔萨雷对阵土耳其杯冠军阿克希萨尔体育。双方在加时赛后战成1比1，阿克希萨尔体育点球大战以5比4获胜，首次夺冠。

en.s: The August 2020 Scottish Conservative Party leadership election was the fifth internal party election to elect the next leader of the Scottish Conservatives, part of the British Conservative Party and the second-largest political party in the devolved Scottish Parliament. zh.s: 2020年8月，苏格兰保守党举行第五次党魁选举，选出下一任党魁。该党是英国保守党的一部分，也是苏格兰权力下放议会中的第二大党。道格拉斯·罗斯在没有对手的情况下参选，并于2020年8月5日获宣布当选党魁。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sri Lanka on 5 August 2020 to elect 225 members to Sri Lanka's 16th Parliament. 16,263,885 people were eligible to vote in the election, 31.95% of whom were young voters. The incumbent Sri Lanka People's Freedom Alliance coalition claimed a landslide victory in the election, winning 145 seats, while Samagi Jana Balawegaya won 54 seats, Tamil National Alliance won 10 seats and National People's Power won 3 seats.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2020年8月5日举行议会选举，选出第16届议会的225名议员。共有16,263,885人具备投票资格，其中31.95%为年轻选民。执政的斯里兰卡人民自由联盟宣称取得压倒性胜利，赢得145席；统一人民力量赢得54席，泰米尔民族联盟赢得10席，民族人民力量赢得3席。

en.t: 2022 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election
en.s: Snap general elections were held in Saint Kitts and Nevis on 5 August 2022, following the decision of incumbent prime minister Timothy Harris to dissolve the parliament on 11 May. Snap elections are constitutionally required within ninety days following the dissolution of parliament. The elections were the first in the country with a female party leader, with businesswoman and environmental consultant Janice Daniel-Hodge leading the Nevis Reformation Party (NRP), which was founded by her father, former Premier of Nevis and pro-Nevis secessionist Simeon Daniel.

zh.s: 圣基茨和尼维斯于2022年8月5日举行提前大选。此前，时任总理蒂莫西·哈里斯于5月11日决定解散议会。按宪法规定，议会解散后90天内必须举行提前选举。这是该国首次有女性担任政党领袖参选：商人兼环境顾问珍妮丝·丹尼尔-霍奇领导尼维斯改革党（NRP）。该党由她的父亲、西蒙·丹尼尔创立；他曾任尼维斯首席部长，并支持尼维斯脱离联邦。

en.s: Verano de Escándalo (Spanish for "Summer of Scandal") was a major professional wrestling event that was produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) promotion, which took place on August 5, 2022, at Arena San Marcos in Aguascalientes, Mexico. The Verano de Escándalo event is a regular summer event for AAA since 1997, with the promotion only skipping the event in 2012, 2013, 2016, and 2020.

zh.s: 《Verano de Escándalo》（西班牙语意为“丑闻之夏”）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟AAA举办的一场大型职业摔角赛事，于2022年8月5日在墨西哥阿瓜斯卡连特斯的圣马科斯竞技场举行。自1997年以来，这一直是AAA每年夏季举办的固定赛事；该联盟仅在2012年、2013年、2016年和2020年停办。

en.s: The 2023 Iraq FA Cup final was the 30th final of the Iraq FA Cup as a club competition. The match was contested between Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya and Erbil, at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad. en.s: The 2023 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Detroit, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 36th annual SummerSlam and took place on August 5, 2023, at Ford Field in Detroit, Michigan, returning the event to its traditional August slot after the previous year's event was held in July.

zh.s: 2023年《SummerSlam》也以“SummerSlam：底特律”为宣传名，是WWE举办的一场职业摔角付费点播和直播赛事，参赛选手来自该联盟的主品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是第36届年度《SummerSlam》，于2023年8月5日在密歇根州底特律的福特球场举行。前一年的赛事在7月举行，本届赛事回到了惯常的8月档期。

en.s: Game4Ukraine was a charity football match played on 5 August 2023 to raise money for the United24 initiative, a fundraiser to help in Ukraine's rebuilding of facilities and infrastructure that suffered damage from the Russian invasion of Ukraine as well as the ongoing Russo-Ukrainian War. It was played at Stamford Bridge, home stadium of Chelsea F.C.

zh.s: Game4Ukraine是一场于2023年8月5日举行的慈善足球赛，为United24倡议筹款。该倡议旨在帮助重建因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰及持续中的俄乌战争而受损的设施和基础设施。比赛在切尔西足球俱乐部主场斯坦福桥球场举行。

en.s: The 2023 Thailand Champions Cup was the 7th Thailand Champions Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Thai League 1 and Thai FA Cup. As Buriram United won both competitions in 2022–23, their opponents were the 2022–23 Thai League 1 runners-up, Bangkok United. It was sponsored by Daikin, and known as the Daikin Thailand Champions Cup (Thai: ไดกิ้น ไทยแลนด์แชมเปียนส์คัพ) for sponsorship purposes. The match was played on 5 August 2023 at the Rajamangala National Stadium in Bang Kapi, Bangkok.

en.t: 2025 Rhode Island Senate District 4 special election
en.s: A special election in the U.S. State of Rhode Island was held August 5, 2025, to elect a new member for District 4 in the Rhode Island Senate, representing part of North Providence. zh.s: 美国罗得岛州于2025年8月5日举行特别选举，为州参议院第4选区选出新议员，该选区涵盖北普罗维登斯的部分地区。此次选举填补了长期担任州参议员兼参议院议长的民主党人多米尼克·J·鲁杰里奥去世后留下的席位空缺；他于2025年4月21日去世。初选于7月8日举行。
